defaults.basis: Preserve existing canonical authority when Davidson and reciprocal institutional evidence conflict and no independent corroboration resolves the field. Raw Davidson evidence remains preserved; only specifically corroborated or deterministic corrections are overridden.
defaults.identity_basis: One real game = one canonical game. Match the uniquely supported reciprocal candidate using same-season companion games, exact/near date-score pairing, result direction, and H/A/N context; preserve field conflicts for separate adjudication. Use FORCE_NEW only when existing candidates are already consumed by distinct real games.
defaults.not_applicable_basis: Conditional discrepancy belongs to an identity candidate not selected by this recommendation map, or the Davidson source game is correctly treated as FORCE_NEW.
